{{dablink|For other uses of the word "tower," see [[Tower]].}}
'''Tower Guards''' are soldiers that defend the [[Aes Sedai]] and the [[White Tower]] in the city of [[Tar Valon]]. They are led by the [[High Captain]], who answers to the [[Amyrlin Seat]].{{ref/book|7|p}}

12,000 Tower Guards were used in the [[Aiel War]] and were part of the [[Great Coalition]].{{verify}}

[[Elaida]], under the influence of [[Alviarin]],{{verify}}<!--This seems probable, but I can't find any direct indicators in the text that the increase in the Tower Guard was specifically done because of Alviarin's influence.--> decreed that the Tower Guard be increased to 50,000 men.{{ref/book|8|15}} However, how large it managed to grow before Egwene took the city is unknown.

The Tower Guard may have been part of the White Tower army during [[Tarmon Gai'don]]. It remained a separate force from the army raised by [[Gareth Bryne]].
